Hi Claire — thanks for sending the docs. I pulled them into the vendor packet and started the verification run. Quick checklist and next steps from our side:

- Received: Harbor_BankLetter.pdf, Harbor_W9.pdf (attached to thread).
- Action: We will initiate two micro-deposits to the account you provided (expected within 1 business day). Please confirm the exact amounts when you see them.
- Wire vs ACH: We support both; we recommend ACH for recurring payouts to reduce fees.
- Invoice mapping: to keep things clean on our side please include a single field labeled "InvoiceRef" that contains the PO number. We will map InvoiceRef => vendor_reference on payment ingestion.
- Remittance layout: we can accept a simple CSV with columns: InvoiceRef, InvoiceDate, GrossAmount, NetAmount, Tax, PaymentDate, PaymentRef. If you prefer XML, send a sample and we'll confirm.

Attachments: vendor_onboard_checklist.pdf (contains our finance onboarding steps and the DocuSign link for payee agreement).

If everything looks good we'll run micro-deposits today and loop back when verified. Targeting activation for Nov 20–22 pending confirmation.

Best,
